text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall despite several short-term setbacks, so I should judge progress over a meaningful horizon rather than react to one month’s return.","Selling Stock B at a gain felt good and selling Stock D at a loss felt painful; neither my average cost nor the urge to lock in a gain should replace a forward-looking assessment of risk and prospects.","I have traded infrequently so far; I should keep that discipline when there is no clear reason to act, while still reviewing diversification and portfolio risk deliberately."]}
